DevOps Engineer

Kfar Saba, Israel · Employee · Expert

Who we are?

Surecomp® is the market-leading provider of digital trade finance solutions for corporates and financial institutions. An industry pioneer for more than thirty-five years, we enable seamless, sustainable trade by breaking down barriers and fostering collaboration. Our award-winning portfolio of cloud and on-premises solutions streamlines the trade finance lifecycle for frictionless transaction processing, enhanced risk mitigation, compliance, decision support, and growth. Underpinned by global offices and an extensive partner network, our prestigious customer footprint spans over eighty countries across the world. For more information visit surecomp.com.

Our Vision and Mission

We believe that sustainable global trade promotes growth and improves people’s lives. The better the world trades, the better society is.

Our Mission is to enable seamless sustainable trade for everyone by removing barriers and facilitating collaboration.


About the Role 

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the DevOps team supporting RIVO, Surecomp's collaborative trade finance platform, used by banks and corporates around the world. 

The DevOps team owns the full path from development environments to production: CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure on AWS, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, observability, and the security and reliability of production systems. Because Surecomp delivers both SaaS and on-premises solutions, part of the work involves automation and deployment challenges in a hybrid setting. 

In this role you will take ownership of real production systems in a regulated financial environment, where reliability, security, and uptime matter to our customers. You will work closely with R&D, QA, Automation, Security, and Delivery teams, and will serve as a technical focal point for infrastructure and deployment topics within the organization. 

Location: Kfar Saba, Israel.

Hybrid: three days a week from the office and two days from home. 

Reporting to: DevOps & CloudOps Team Leader


Roles and Responsibilities 

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Build, operate, and secure production cloud environments on AWS. 
  • Develop and maintain containerized applications and services running on Docker and Kubernetes. 
  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code. 
  • Write infrastructure automation scripts for cloud deployments. 
  • Build and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities. 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues related to cloud infrastructure and services. 
  • Contribute to configuration management and security practices across environments. 
  • Keep up to date with relevant DevOps and cloud technologies and propose improvements. 

Requirements

Knowledge and Experience 

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a DevOps Engineer - Must. 
  • Experience with containers (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes) - Must. 
  • Experience writing infrastructure as code (Terraform, OpenTofu or Pulumi). 
  • Experience building and maintaining CI pipelines (Jenkins, Github Actions, or equivalent). 
  • Experience engineering and scaling CD pipelines and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent). 
  • Experience operating production environments on AWS. 
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Datadog, Grafana and Prometheus, or equivalent). 
  • Strong Linux background and solid scripting skills with Python and Bash. 
  • Experience with Git-based version control (Github or similar). 
  • Good understanding of networking, storage, and compute concepts. 
  • Familiarity with security and compliance practices in production environments. 
  • Professional-level English, written and spoken. 

Advantages 

  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible. 
  • Experience in a fintech, banking, or other regulated environment. 

Skills 

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities. 
  • Hands-on, proactive, and results-oriented, with a "get things done" attitude. 
  • Able to work independently and prioritize effectively across multiple tasks. 
  • Good communication and collaboration skills across technical teams. 
  • Comfortable working in a global, multicultural environment. 
  • Attention to detail, especially around production reliability and security.
